name: City Journey 02 · Frozen Blocks

signs.text: FROZEN TRAFFIC: Four sealed circuits. Brake before each crossing. Both directions matter; the outside edges are water.
FIRST CIRCUIT: Skaters loop in squares. Cross one line, settle your slide, then read the next. Roaches can steal your waiting space.
CHECKPOINT: Two circuits ahead. Opposing squares overlap; rushing through both at once is dangerous.
FINAL CIRCUIT: Watch the exit bugs as well as the skaters. No outside route around the traffic.

description: Four sealed ice gauntlets. Cross dense opposing skater lines and overlapping square circuits; roaches occupy braking and exit approaches.
